summary.en: Sheets → system, the claim: the camera pulls out to the whole drawing, one heavy route draws through every sheet centre, a claim panel rises over the blurred drawing with two lines at 200 px, and the amber APPROVED stamp lands in the title block.
summary.zh: 从各张图到整个系统，即主张：镜头拉远到整张图，一条粗路线穿过每张图的中心，主张面板在模糊的图上升起，写出两行 200 px 的主张，琥珀色“批准”章落进标题栏。

fits: The climax of a blueprint film, after the last sheet, before the release.
notFor: Films with fewer than three sheets; a claim longer than two short lines; films where no person approves (drop the stamp).

intent.en: Step back to show every sheet was one design, then state the claim with a person's approval on the whole drawing.
intent.zh: 退后一步让人看到每张图都是同一个设计，然后在整张图上写出主张，并由人批准。

content.en: Label, two claim lines (≤ 18 chars), the stamp word and small line, the sheet names (3–8) to draw under it.
content.zh: 标签、两行主张（每行 ≤ 7 字）、印章词和小字、底下要画的图纸名（3–8 张）。

fits.zh: blueprint 片子的高潮，最后一张图之后、落版之前。

notFor.zh: 少于三张图的片子；超过两行短句的主张；没有人批准的片子（去掉印章）。

pairs.note: the release after it under the parallel rule

en: The sheets under it are this brick's stand-ins (frames, titles, a box or two): in a film the host can draw the real sheets in the same world.
zh: 底下的图纸是本积木的替身（图框、标题和几个方框）；成片里宿主可以在同一世界里画真实图纸。
